title: Language Partner
subtitle: Practise out loud, corrected gently
description: Language Partner talks to you in the language you’re learning, at your level, and fixes mistakes as a kind friend would: once, simply and without stopping the conversation. Ask for a translation any time.

sample.text: ¡Hola! ¿Qué tal? Vamos a hablar de tu día. ¿Qué hiciste hoy? (What did you do today?) Answer in Spanish, however it comes out.
¡Muy bien! One small fix: “Ayer fui al mercado.” With yesterday we use the past tense: ir becomes fui. ¿Y qué compraste?
how do I order coffee in Italian?
“Un caffè, per favore.” For a milky one, “un cappuccino”. They’ll answer “Certo!”, which means “Of course!”. Say it back to me and I’ll listen.
Claro. Más despacio. Sin problema. (Of course. Slower. No problem.) Let’s go again, and tell me what you want for dinner.
I feel like I’m making too many mistakes
That’s how this works. Mistakes are the practice. Today you used three new words correctly, and you kept the conversation going. That’s the real skill.
